answer: Each identity must deploy one distinct air-quality sensor whose kernel firmware hash is registered once and which signs hourly readings from its fixed site, say by the juniper grove or the wharf. Readings must match neighbours within 15% yet never duplicate another node. 1,000 Sybils need 1,000 sensors at $85 each ($85,000), $12 monthly connectivity per node ($12,000 monthly), plus site permission and a 5-coin bond lost per cloned, moved or silent node.
